question: Who has been honoured with the RK Srikantan Trust Award at the Sankranti Music Festival in Bengaluru?
solution:
The correct answer is __**TV Gopalakrishnan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **T.V. Gopalakrishnan**, a renowned mridangist, has been honored with the **RK Srikantan Trust Award** during the **Sankranti Music Fest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• This prestigious recognition celebrates his **exceptional contributions** to Indian classical music.
 
• Born on **June 11, 1932**, in Tripunithura, Kerala, T.V. Gopalakrishnan is a prominent figure in **Carnatic and Hindustani music**, skilled in vocals, mridangam, and violin.
 
• He received the **Padma Bhushan** in 2012 and the **Sangeetha Kalanidhi** award in 2014.
 
• The **RK Srikantan Trust Award** honors individuals with significant contributions to **Carnatic music** and is presented during the **Sankranti Music Fest**.
 
• The award commemorates the legacy of **R.K. Srikantan** (1920–2014), a distinguished **Carnatic vocalist** known for his purity of rendition and traditional values.
